newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac to arrange GM Australia MTN programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac to arrange GM Australia MTN programme.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corporation said on Tuesday General Motors Acceptance Corporation Australia, the Australian finance unit of General Motors, had mandated it to arrange a domestic medium term note programme.
Westpac said the programme was to allow GMAC Australia to further diversify its funding base with the notes guaranteed by GMAC Australia's parent company, General Motors Acceptance Corp.
The amount to be raised through the programme was not disclosed.
Other dealers on the programme include Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Swiss Bank Corp and Citibank.
